integrity: The universal trace identity is proved by exact Boolean-lattice Möbius cancellation, with independent finite oriented-chain and character checks for n=4..7; no external independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Rational representations only; relies on Nilakantan–Singh nonequivariant homology concentration; no integral lattice or equivariant homotopy type is proved; n=6 specialization has been reported previously; unindexed equivalent work is possible.
title: Complete \(S_n\)-homology representations of two-subset Kneser neighborhood complexes
